title: Basic Signal Inversion
description: Design a circuit that takes an input signal A from Data Switch 0 and outputs its complement A' to LED 0 using a 7404 Hex Inverter IC.
author: LogicMan Team
hints: Don't forget to power the 7404 IC: Pin 14 to +5V (VCC) and Pin 7 to GND!
Pin 1 is the input to the first inverter, and Pin 2 is its output.
